newsitem.title: SYRIA: Syria cancels tender to buy 26,000 tonnes sugar.
newsitem.headline: Syria cancels tender to buy 26,000 tonnes sugar.

text.p: Syria's General Foreign Trade Organisation for Chemicals and Foostuffs (Geza) on Wednesday again cancelled a tender to buy 13,000 tonnes of white sugar and 13,000 tonnes of raws, a Geza spokesman said.
He told Reuters the tender was cancelled because price offers did not meet Geza conditions. The sugar was for delivery in August.
The tender was originally issued on May 19 and had already seen a previous cancellation on June 17.
